Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

RGenEDA 0.99.1

Breaking changes

  • extractEigen() and PlotEigenHeatmap(): the PctVar column and row annotation are renamed to Contribution. The value is each gene’s percent share of the PC’s squared loadings (100 * v^2 / sum(v^2)), not the percent of variance it explains. The values are unchanged.
  • DimReduction$percent_var is now a named numeric vector of percents (e.g. 85.43) instead of strings such as "85.43 %". PlotPCA() and PlotScree() use it directly, and the validity check rejects non-numeric values. Re-run RunPCA() on objects saved with older versions.
  • Imports use importFrom() only. grDevices was added to Imports, and scales was removed. vegan moved to Suggests: PlotOrdCorr() needs it installed.

Behaviour changes

  • PlotEigenCorr() adjusts p-values for multiple testing with p.adjust() (new argument p_adjust_method, default "BH"). It returns padj_matrix and uses it for the stars and the plot. Raw p-values are still in pval_matrix.
  • PlotOrdCorr() uses the same multiple-testing correction (p_adjust_method, default "BH") and returns padj_matrix.
  • p_adjust_method in PlotEigenCorr() and PlotOrdCorr() no longer accepts "none". Raw p-values and padj are always both returned, and the plots always use padj.

New features

  • Added as(object, "SummarizedExperiment") to convert a geneda object (with its HVGs, PCA and DEG tables) to a SummarizedExperiment. as.geneda() reads that layout back, so the round trip is lossless.
  • All main functions accept a SummarizedExperiment (including DESeqDataSet and DESeqTransform) directly. FindVariableFeatures(), RunPCA(), SetDEGs() and FilterDEGs() return the input object with the results added.
  • as.geneda() uses an assay named "normalized" when there is one.
  • Added inst/scripts/make-Snail1KO.R, which rebuilds the Snail1KO dataset from Expression Atlas (E-MTAB-5244). ?Snail1KO now gives the dimensions, organism and cell line, gene ID type, processing and licence (CC BY 4.0).
  • Added a package man page (?RGenEDA) and inst/CITATION (citation("RGenEDA")). Cleaned up the accessor titles and removed references to functions that do not exist from the generatePCs() and FindVariableFeatures() docs.

Bug fixes and documentation

  • Consistent PCA terms: “scores” for samples (DimReduction$Scores, ExtractPCA()) and “loadings” (rotation) for genes (DimReduction$Eigenvectors). Fixed stale references to a Loadings element in the validity check, the PlotEigenHeatmap() error and the DimReduction() / generatePCs() docs.
  • PlotMA(): padj is now a required column. NA values in padj are treated as not significant (smallest point, never labelled). The duplicate scale_size() was removed, and the legend now shows the inclusive thresholds.
  • PlotPCA() no longer uses the deprecated aes_string().
  • GenSave() checks its input before it opens a graphics device, and always closes the device (even on error). It also accepts a plain pheatmap object.
  • SetDEGs() now rejects DEG tables with automatic row names (1, 2, …). The old is.null(rownames()) check could never be true.
  • Gene variances are computed with MatrixGenerics::rowVars() (MatrixGenerics added to Imports).
  • PlotDistances(): the heatmap now clusters on the sample distances, so the plotted order matches the returned order. reorder = FALSE now turns off clustering in the plot. The docs are corrected: it is a pheatmap, and meta_cols are drawn as annotation strips.
  • Documentation now states the scope as bulk RNA-seq (DESeq2 workflow) instead of “multiple omics data types”. Outdated vignette text and typos fixed.

RGenEDA 0.99.0

  • Renumbered to 0.99.0 for Bioconductor submission (continues from 2.1.0).
  • Added as.geneda() to build a geneda object from a SummarizedExperiment, DESeqDataSet, or DESeqTransform, carrying over counts, normalized values, colData, and optional DEG tables. Normalized values can come from an assay, a transformed object, a matrix, or be computed with DESeq2 vst or log2 CPM.
  • Added biocViews, URL, and BugReports fields to DESCRIPTION.
  • Removed LazyData; load the example data with data(Snail1KO).
  • Added runnable examples for all exported functions using the bundled Snail1KO data.
  • Documented return values for FindHVDEGs() and the show() method.
  • Replaced sapply() with vapply() and 1:n with seq_len().
  • Vignette now uses accessors instead of @ slot access and reports sessionInfo().
  • Restyled code to Bioconductor style (4-space indents, 80-character lines).

RGenEDA 2.1.0

  • Fixed cosmetics of printing statements.
  • Minor bug fixes in PCA functions and accessors.

RGenEDA 2.0.2

  • Fixed bug in RunPCA() where PCs beyond 10 were named NA.
  • Fixed bug in PlotScree() where PCs beyond 10 were shown as NA.

RGenEDA 2.0.1

  • Added PlotScree().
  • PCA utilities now generate PCs dynamically up to PC10.
  • Renamed DimReduction$Loadings to DimReduction$Scores.
  • Added scree plot to the vignette.

RGenEDA 2.0.0

  • Added assay argument to SetDEGs(), PlotMA(), and FilterDEGs() (with saveAssay).
  • Added PlotVolcano(), FindHVDEGs(), and GenSave().
  • Renamed eigencorr, ordcorr, and distanceHeatmap to PlotEigenCorr(), PlotOrdCorr(), and PlotDistances().
  • Replaced the pasilla demo with the Snail1 KO dataset (Maturi et al., 2018).

RGenEDA 1.0.2

  • Fixed example blocks in roxygen headers.
  • Addressed all R CMD check errors, warnings, and notes.

RGenEDA 1.0.1

  • All heatmaps now use pheatmap.
  • Fixed top-gene-loading bug in PlotEigenHeatmap().
  • Added optional DEGs slot to interface with DESeq2.
  • Added MA plot functionality.

RGenEDA 1.0.0

  • Introduced the S4 geneda object.
  • Added methods for HVG calculation and PCA storage.
  • Added PCA, HVG variance, and eigenvector plots.
  • Eigencorrelation plots now use the top HVGs from HVG selection/PCA.
  • Added unit tests and a pasilla vignette.

RGenEDA 0.0.0.900

  • Initial standalone functions: variance, PCA, Euclidean distances, and eigenvector correlations.
